description: This file is a Spring Boot configuration class for the Eclipse Hono device registry application. It defines Spring beans for application properties, external services integration, endpoints, health check, metrics, tracing, and security components.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for setting up beans related to the Device Registry application, including Vert.x, Tracer, properties, endpoints, and health checks.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Creates and exposes a Vert.x instance configured with VertxProperties.

methods.name: vertxProperties
methods.description: Provides VertxProperties configured via application properties.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Provides an OpenTracing Tracer, resolved via service loader or defaulting to a no-op tracer.

methods.name: applicationConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides general application configuration properties.

methods.name: healthCheckConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides health check server configuration properties.

methods.name: amqpProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the AMQP endpoint.

methods.name: registrationAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new RegistrationAmqpEndpoint instance.

methods.name: credentialsAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new CredentialsAmqpEndpoint instance.

methods.name: tenantAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new TenantAmqpEndpoint instance.

methods.name: deviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint instance.

methods.name: restProperties
methods.description: Provides REST API configuration properties.

methods.name: registrationHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint, conditional on the presence of DeviceManagementService.

methods.name: credentialsHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint, conditional on the presence of CredentialsManagementService.

methods.name: tenantHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a TenantManagementHttpEndpoint, conditional on the presence of TenantManagementService.

methods.name: serviceProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration for the device registration service.

methods.name: credentialsProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration for the credentials service.

methods.name: tenantsProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration for the tenants service.

methods.name: deviceConnectionsProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration for device connection service.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Customizer for metrics registry to add common tags.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Creates and exposes the health check server.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Provides a password encoder for securing credentials.
